RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, the April  16, 2002/Chaitra 26, 1924 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Civil Aviation; Commerce and Industry; Finance; Petroleum and
Natural Gas; Tourism and Culture; Water Resources)
Total number of questions—155
519
WIN2\SESSION\89RS 519
International airport at
Shamshabad
2368. SHRI AIMADUDDIN AHMED
KHAN (DURRU): Will the Minister of
CIVIL AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether a State of the art international
airport is proposed to be constructed at
Shamshabad, near Hyderabad;
(b) if so, the main features and estimated
cost thereof; and
(c) what is the State Government's
contribution thereto?
New International airports
2369. SHRI MAN MOHAN SAMAL:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are opening
new international airports keeping in view
the "Open Sky Policy" to facilitate tourism
in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) what are the details of the domestic
airports which have been identified for
further development as International
Airports; and
(d) what are the details of the plans for
the same?
Amendment to Route Disbursal
Guidelines
2370. SHRI RAJEEV SHUKLA: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Bagdogra
figures in the list of Category II routes under
the Route Disbursal Guidelines, issued by
Directorate General of Civil Aviation;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether any proposal to amend this
has been submitted to Government by
Directorate General of Civil Aviation;
(d) if so, what action has been taken by
the Ministry of Civil Aviation on this
proposal so far; and
(e) what  are  the  details  of the  routes
being  covered by  all  the  scheduled  airlines,
route-wise?

520
WIN2\SESSION\89RS 520
Direct flight to China
2371. SHRI K. KALAVENKATA
RAO:
SHRIMATI VANGA GEETHA:
SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY:
SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is no direct air link
with China; and
(b) if so, the action taken to start a direct
passenger flight to China to boost bilateral
ties and tourism?
IA flights on unviable routes
2372. SHRI ABANI ROY: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the Indian Airlines have been
plying its services on several routes which
are unviable;
(b) if so, the details thereof and losses
suffered on such routes during the last three
years;
(c) whether Government's policies have
been causing losses to the Indian Airlines;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the steps taken by Government to
revise its policies to make it profitable?
Accident of an aircraft at Palam
Airport
2373. SHRI ABANI ROY: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether an aircraft of Indian Airlines
rammed into the parameter wall  of the Palam
Airport as reported in all the Newspapers
on 9th March, 2002;
(b) if so, the exact loss suffered to the
aircraft as a result thereof;
(c) whether Government have fixed any
responsibility in this regard;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the steps taken by Government to
avoid such incidents in future?
Expansion of Bilaspur Airport
†2374. SHRI DILIP SINGH JUDEV:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal to
develop runway into a full fledged Airport
at Bilaspur  in Chhattisgarh;
(b) if so, what action would be taken for
the expansion of this airport to make it more
convenient;
(c) the proposed outline of the same;
and
(d) what is the present capacity of
Bilaspur Airport?
Performance parameters of IA
2375. SHRI B.J. PANDA: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) the performance parameter of Indian
Airlines in terms of seat load factor, market
share in percentage, the total number of
passengers in the month of October 2001
as compared to August 2001; and
(b)  how   it   stands   as   compared  to
Air Sahara and Jet Airlines?
New airport at Ajmer, Rajasthan
2376. SHRIMATI VANGA GEETHA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:

WIN2\SESSION\89RS 521
(a) whether Rajasthan Government has
demanded that an airport be constructed at
Ajmer, a Pilgrim Centre in Rajasthan;
(b) whether a demand has also been
made to provide flights for all parts of the
country from there; and
(c) if so, what is Government's response
to these demands?
New airport in Uttarkashi
2377. SHRI ANIL SHARMA: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have any plan
to construct a new airport in or around
Uttarkashi;
(b) whether any helipad/airport is
functioning in Uttarkashi;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(d) by when, Government are going to
construct a new airport in Uttarkashi?
Upgradation of fleet operation

LINGAM: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased
